title: CODATA 2022: an alpha particle is 7294.299 541 71 electron masses
summary: The standard uncertainty on the ratio is 0.000 000 17. The alpha mass in u is 4.001 506 179 129.
body: The NIST 2022 listing prints 'alpha particle-electron mass ratio 7294.299 541 71' with standard uncertainty '0.000 000 17'. It prints 'alpha particle mass in u 4.001 506 179 129' with standard uncertainty '0.000 000 000 062' u. The kilogram mass and the MeV equivalent are on the alpha-particle card. The ratio is the direct comparison with the electron.
